title: Hand off through waggledance when feature start hits handoff_due
action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1-D6. New module verbs/handoff_door.rs owns the data shape: enum HandoffDoor { Absent, Present { binary, project_id } }, struct HandoffRequest { project_id, follow_up_of: Option<String>, request_id, task_file }, enum HandoffOutcome { Sent { run_id, request_id }, Failed { reason } }; pure fns build_request(...) and dispatch_argv(&HandoffRequest) -> Vec<String>, a pure fn find_follow_up(runs_json, agent_id) -> Option<String> (pane_id == paseo:<agent_id>), a pure fn compose_task_text(merged, feature, class, lane, files, flags, owner_text) -> String, and a thin shell that probes the door (reuse waggledance_binary and the waggledance list --json read in hooks/write_guard/cross_project.rs, exposing what you need as pub(crate); match root_path to the main root and take that row's id), runs waggledance runs --project <id> --full, writes the task file under <main root>/.bee/tmp/, runs waggledance dispatch and parses run_id from its JSON stdout. In verbs/feature_group.rs handoff_due branch: add flag handoff-task to keys_known and the flag registry (regen registry_payload.json with bee dev regen); when the door is Present and config handoff_auto is not false: --same-session refuses with [handoff_due] --same-session is not accepted while bee can hand off; no --handoff-task refuses with [handoff_due] naming --handoff-task; with it, dispatch, then on Sent release the session (call the same code bee state session release uses), append audit kind handoff-dispatched (add it to the known kinds in audit.rs) with run id and request id in the note, and fail with [handoff_sent] run <run_id>: this session is released; tell the owner in one line and stop. On Failed fail with [handoff_failed] <reason> and write nothing. Door Absent or handoff_auto false: today's behavior unchanged. Make handoff_auto a governed config key in the governed view in hooks/write_guard/guards.rs so bee config set refuses it. Add unit tests for the pure fns. No code comments.

must_haves.why: Agents waive the handoff with their own reason; bee must do the handoff itself.
truths: with a present door and handoff_auto on, no agent-supplied flag lets a second feature open in the same session
the dispatch argv carries --leader, --request-id bee-handoff-<session>-<feature>, --task-file, and --follow-up-of <run> --handoff only when a run matches
door absent keeps the existing --same-session waiver and its tests green
prohibitions: No HANDOFF.json write on this path
No fallback to a waiver after a failed dispatch
